commit_scope: Allow Codex local-environment setup to complete before a newly created task worktree has an attached branch, while preserving the repository start gate for active tasks and after branch attachment.
evidence_refs: The Codex environment wrapper sourced the selected setup script from a newly created linked worktree whose git branch resolved to HEAD.
The original setup exited 2 because make start-gate intentionally rejects detached HEAD before the task thread can attach its codex branch.
The regression fixture proves only detached setup without CODEX_THREAD_ID exits 0 with an explicit deferral; an active detached task and an attached setup both invoke start-gate.
The exact patched setup script passes in the attached repair worktree.
